prompt: An eerie, abandoned carnival at twilight. A rusty Ferris wheel stands silent against the dark sky. A single, chipped carousel horse is frozen mid-gallop. The tilted ticket booth is empty, with a discarded ticket on the ground. Next to a collapsed striped tent, a popcorn machine with a broken glass pane sits beside a lonely stuffed animal prize. A funhouse mirror reflects a distorted, empty view. Nearby, a high striker game with its hammer lies on the ground, next to a few scattered hoopla rings. An empty soda bottle are near a weathered bench. The scene is one of decay and silence; there is no crowd of people, no fresh food, and no vendor in sight. All the rides are still, so there are no functioning rides or lit-up signs, and there are certainly no balloons floating around.
